evals.name: add-new-anthropic-boms
evals.prompt: We just got 3 new BOM files from Anthropic locations (Australia, Canada, US-Cluster1). They need to be consolidated into our master BOM with the existing IREN and NScale components. Can you help me consolidate them?
evals.expected_output: Interactive wizard that guides through 6 steps: (1) discovers the 3 Anthropic files, (2) extracts customer/location metadata, (3) maps sections, (4) identifies duplicates with existing ~78 components, (5) shows aggregation preview, (6) updates master BOM and pushes to GitHub

evals.name: update-quantities-mackenzie
evals.prompt: The Mackenzie site sent updated quantities for their BOM. I need to update the existing Mackenzie_IREN.xlsx file in my master consolidation. The quantities changed but component names are the same.
evals.expected_output: Wizard reads updated file, matches existing components by Model/PN, updates quantities, regenerates dashboard with new totals, commits & pushes to GitHub with message about Mackenzie update

evals.name: consolidate-from-scratch
evals.prompt: I'm starting fresh with a new BOM consolidation. I have 5 files from different suppliers (3 IREN, 2 Anthropic) in my BOMs folder. I need to consolidate them all into a master file with proper sections, deduplication, and metadata extraction.
evals.expected_output: Full wizard flow: discovers 5 files, extracts metadata from filenames, identifies sections in each file, deduplicates across all 5, aggregates to final master, creates initial GitHub commit with all components organized by section
